## Falsifiable acceptance criteria

1. Every backend that any tier in the deployed `routing_tiers.yaml` references either resolves a complete `endpoint_url` on the lane, or is not referenced by that lane's tiers. Falsified by a `BACKENDS_LOADED` readback missing a referenced backend.
2. `test`, `summarization` and `documentation` each resolve a zero-cost local rung before any metered rung on the dev lane.
3. A startup or deploy-time check fails when the deployed tier config references a backend the deployed bifrost contract cannot resolve — the same class of silent drift OMN-16811 closed at the task-class layer.
